Evidence

What the simulation records revealed

The team tested rescue missions in environments of increasing complexity. The event records showed fewer exchanges between agents in more complex scenarios. In a separate comparison with human teams, coordination and emerging leadership were weaker among agents.

The communication pattern was observed in simulated teams. Its generality to human teams remains an open question.

UIST paper Scaling study and discussion SEA workshop paper

Research question & method

How can researchers create and inspect dynamic teams of LLM agents?

I led backend development and optimization, implementing scalable event scheduling and LLM reasoning pipelines with Python, WebSockets, and GPT-4o-mini. My work supported real-time coordination across autonomous agents; the platform and research are collaborative work.

Event scheduling and agent coordination

Studying agent teams requires more than running several prompts. A simulation must coordinate agents, represent a changing environment, and expose what happened. VirT-Lab supports configurable scenarios and agent roles in interactive 2D environments.

  1. Schedule agent events

    Coordinate actions over simulation time while agents move, communicate, and respond to the environment.

  2. Connect reasoning to action

    Integrate LLM reasoning pipelines with the simulation engine and real-time communication infrastructure.

  3. Make behavior inspectable

    Support a platform in which researchers can follow agent actions, conversations, and simulation records.

Next question

When do patterns in an agent simulation tell us something meaningful about human teams?

Simulation realism and human-team validity need to be evaluated separately from software performance. More realistic-looking behavior alone does not establish that a simulation predicts human collaboration.
